constraints: byteOrder selects how the 2 read bytes are interpreted: 0 = native byte ordering, 1 = Macintosh byte ordering, 2 = PC byte ordering.
If offset is omitted, reading starts at the beginning of the BLOB (byte 0).

overloadMerges.note: offset is typed Variable and documented/arrow-marked as inout ('<->': input starting byte position, output updated to the position just after the value read), not a plain input Integer, even though the draft parser defaulted it to direction:in.

params.name: offset
params.description: Byte offset to read from; on return, updated to the offset immediately following the read 2-byte value.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Reads a 2-byte Integer from blob at the given (or default) byte offset using byteOrder's byte ordering, advancing offset past the value read.
